crossRefs.note: Then the king sent a captain of fifty with his fifty to him. He went up to him; and behold, he was sitting on the top…
Though you grind a fool in a mortar with a pestle along with grain, yet his foolishness will not be removed from him.
Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? Then may you also do good, who are accustomed to do evil.
“It will happen afterward, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh; and your sons and your daughters will prophesy.…

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: When Saul was told, he sent other messengers, and they also prophesied. Saul sent messengers again the third time, and they also prophesied.
translations.bsb: When this was reported to Saul, he sent more messengers, but they began to prophesy as well. So Saul tried again and sent messengers a third time, and even they began to prophesy.
translations.kjv: And when it was told Saul, he sent other messengers, and they prophesied likewise. And Saul sent messengers again the third time, and they prophesied also.
translations.asv: And when it was told Saul, he sent other messengers, and they also prophesied. And Saul sent messengers again the third time, and they also prophesied.
